content: sam_read1 (50 lines): format-dispatched — reads one record from BAM (binary), SAM (text), or CRAM. For BAM: reads block_size (4 bytes LE), then block_size bytes of binary record data into bam1_t. For SAM: calls sam_parse1 (#64). For CRAM: delegates to cram_get_bam_seq (not replaceable). Depends on: pure Rust BGZF (#65) for BAM, sam_parse1 (#64) for SAM.
